verdict.rationale: 1Password documents creating, saving, and signing in with passkeys from its browser extension (docs-12, docs-14). Passkey support also appears in Watchtower (docs-13), and iOS 26+ can import credentials via the Credential Exchange standard (docs-17). This implies passkeys live in a vendor-neutral vault rather than one platform's keychain, but the pack never shows passkeys syncing to native iOS, Android, Windows, or Linux apps. missing for 10: explicit documentation of passkey sync and use across iOS, Android, Windows, and Linux apps, platform-level passkey provider integration (e.g. Android/iOS credential provider), and hands-on or independent corroboration of cross-ecosystem passkey use.
